_comment: Packaging defaults by category and APPROXIMATE USPS retail rates, used only when no label API is connected. Real rates come from Shippo (or the platform's own label). Media Mail is for books, printed music, CDs/DVDs/vinyl and other recorded media without advertising; video games and electronics are not eligible.

packing: Wrap the book in a plastic bag (rain)
Check the disc is in its case

shoes.box: shoe box inside a shipping box
packing: Original box if you have it
Put the shoe box inside a shipping box; don't tape the shoe box itself
Factory reset and sign out of accounts
Fill gaps so it can't move

platform_labels.poshmark: Poshmark emails a prepaid label (buyer pays) when it sells
platform_labels.mercari: Print the prepaid label from the sale page in the Mercari app
platform_labels.ebay: Buy the label on eBay (Sold > Print shipping label), or let earnest buy one through Shippo
platform_labels.buyback: The buyback vendor emails a free prepaid label

drop_off: Drop it at any USPS location or blue box (if it fits), or schedule a free USPS Package Pickup from usps.com.
